newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway says will upgrade GDP forecast on May 13.
newsitem.headline: Norway says will upgrade GDP forecast on May 13.

text.p: Norwegian Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg said on Tuesday he would upgrade the Gross Domestic Product forecast for 1997 in the revised national budget to be unveiled on May 13.
Stoltenberg, speaking at an Association of Processing Industry conference, also said he would revise investment and jobless forecasts.
Stoltenberg would not reveal what the new forecasts for GDP and investments would be, but said both mainland and overall GDP forecasts would be revised upwards.
Mainland GDP excludes the booming offshore petroleum sector.
Employment growth would be upgraded to 40,000 from 30,000 in the national budget forecast presented on November 29, he said.
This corresponds to a downgrading of the jobless rate forecast to 4.25 percent from 4.5 percent, Stoltenberg said.
In November, the finance ministry forecast overall GDP growth this year at 3.1 percent and mainland GDP at 2.5 percent.
